038package dev.visdb.seesaw.table;
039
040/**
041 * This abstract class is provided as a convenience for creating
042 * custom SsDataGridHandler objects. Extend this class to create a
043 * SsDataGridHandler implementation.
044 * <p>
045 * SsDataGridHandlerImpl defines empty functions so that the programmer can define
046 * only the functions desired.
047 */
048// TODO Should this class be named SsDataGridHandlerImpl?
049// TODO Can this be eliminated by making empty default metholds to SsDataGridHandler?
050public abstract class SsDataGridAdapter implements SsDataGridHandler {
051  /**
052   * This empty implementation always returns true.
053   * For description about the function look in SSRowDeletion class.
054   *
055   * @param row    the row number in data grid.
056   */
057  @Override
058  public boolean allowDeletion(int row) {
059    return true;
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Method to perform post-deletion operations.
064   *
065   * @param row the position of deleted row in the data grid.
066   */
067  @Override
068  public void performPostDeletionOps(int row) {
069    // do nothing
070  }
071
072  /**
073   * Method to perform post-insertion operations.
074   *
075   * @param row position of added row in the data grid.
076   */
077  @Override
078  public void performPostInsertOps(int row) {
079    // do nothing
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Method to perform pre-deletion operations.
084   *
085   * @param row position of data grid row being deleted.
086   */
087  @Override
088  public void performPreDeletionOps(int row) {
089    // do nothing
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * Method to perform pre-insertion operations.
094   *
095   * @param row position of new row in the data grid.
096   */
097  @Override
098  public void performPreInsertOps(int row) {
099    // do nothing
100  }
101}
